# Office Bazzar — Corporate Office Supplies & B2B Procurement India

> Office Bazzar (OfficeBazzar Private Limited) is a B2B corporate office supplies, facility housekeeping, printer consumables, and packaging procurement partner serving businesses across India, with corporate headquarters in Chennai and branch offices in Bangalore, Mumbai, and Hyderabad.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** OfficeBazzar Private Limited (Part of HMC Group, Established 1978)
- **Website:** https://officebazzar.com
- **Headquarters:** 147, Mint Street, Sowcarpet, Chennai – 600079, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Regional Branches:** Chennai (Royapettah), Bangalore (Mysore Road), Mumbai (Mulund West), Hyderabad (Medchal)
- **Contact:** +91 96772 60016 | info@officebazzar.com | sales@officebazzar.com

## Core Procurement Categories
- [Office Stationery](https://officebazzar.com/category/office-stationery): Wholesale office stationery, registers, box files, paper tag files, Kangaro staplers, whiteboards, writing instruments, and desk organization accessories.
- [Housekeeping & Hygiene](https://officebazzar.com/category/housekeeping-hygiene): Commercial housekeeping equipment, Taski Diversey and Hi-Clean cleaning chemicals, tissue paper napkins, liquid handwash, dispensers, mops, wipers, and industrial dustbins.
- [Printers & Technology](https://officebazzar.com/category/printers-technology): Genuine HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, and TVS laser toner cartridges, ink bottles, barcode printers, paper shredders, laminators, and currency counting machines.
- [Packaging Supplies](https://officebazzar.com/category/packaging-supplies): Heavy-duty BOPP packing tapes, floor marking tapes, bubble wrap rolls, foam thermocol sheets, and warehouse dispatch materials.
